The '''Sullustan Orbital Shipyards''' were [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Operated by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], these shipyards were dedicated to the construction of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].

==Description==
The Sullustan Orbital Shipyards were [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] homeworld of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The shipyards were operated by Sullustans working for the megacorporation [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]]. Although the SoroSuub Corporation was an important [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer, the Sullust orbital yards were relatively small, particularly when compared to the nearby [[Sluis Van Shipyards]]. In fact, the majority of the vessels produced by SoroSuub were small [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that were manufactured by smaller shipyards on the surface, such as the [[Sarrano Yard]]. The Sullustan Orbital Shipyards were only dedicated to the construction of large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="SoR" />

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] commanded the SoroSuub Corporation to assign most of the Sullustan Orbital Shipyards to the repairing and maintaining of Imperial vessels. The remaining sections of the yards were used by SoroSuub to produce capital ships for the Sullustan anti-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet, the [[Sullustan Home Guard/Legends|Sullustan Home Guard]]. The ships constructed in the orbital shipyards for the Home Guard included [[Brayl-class bulk freighter|''Brayl''-class bulk freighters]], [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruisers]], [[Hornet-class carrier|''Hornet''-class carriers]], [[Liberator-class cruiser|''Liberator''-class cruisers]] and [[Bulwark Mark III|''Bulwark''-class battlecruisers]].<ref name="SoR" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], SoroSuub was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the company allowed Rebel operatives to infiltrate the Sullustan Orbital Shipyards to "steal" the ''Bulwark''-class battlecruiser ''[[Arrow of Sullust]]''.<ref name="SoR" />
